meta.name: dynamodb
meta.description: AWS DynamoDB NoSQL database for scalable data storage. Use when designing table schemas, writing queries, configuring indexes, managing capacity, implementing single-table design, or troubleshooting performance issues.

copy.tagline: 设计表结构、编写查询、配置索引、管理容量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用或计划使用 DynamoDB 构建应用
copy.tagline_en: Design table schemas, write queries, configure indexes, manage capacity
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are using or planning to use DynamoDB for your application

howto.what: Claude 能帮你设计 DynamoDB 表结构、编写查询、配置索引、管理容量、实现单表设计，并排查性能问题。
howto.when: 当你需要创建或优化 DynamoDB 表、编写 CRUD 操作、设置索引、处理限流或热分区等问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个用户表的 DynamoDB 表结构。
say.note: Claude 会给出主键、索引等建议。

say.text: 写一个 Python 查询，按用户ID获取所有订单。
say.note: Claude 会生成 boto3 查询代码。

say.text: 我的表出现限流错误，怎么排查？
say.note: Claude 会分析原因并给出解决方案。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you design DynamoDB table schemas, write queries, configure indexes, manage capacity, implement single-table design, and troubleshoot performance issues.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to create or optimize DynamoDB tables, write CRUD operations, set up indexes, or handle throttling and hot partitions.

say_en.text: Help me design a DynamoDB table schema for users.
say_en.note: Claude will suggest keys and indexes.

say_en.text: Write a Python query to get all orders by user ID.
say_en.note: Claude will generate boto3 query code.

say_en.text: My table is throttling, how to debug?
say_en.note: Claude will analyze causes and solutions.
